checkable_as.checkable_as: The list of covers names simple theft away from home (einfacher Diebstahl auswärts) either as included or as not included. A cover list that is silent about it does not show this item.
checkable_as.item: the supplementary insurance for simple theft away (Ziff. 24.2), or its absence

checkable_as.checkable_as: An amount in CHF labelled as the sum insured for household contents (Versicherungssumme Hausrat).

questions.label: Q1
questions.question: Does the file state that the measures could not wait for the insurer's instruction because of imminent danger (Gefahr im Verzug)?

questions.label: Q2
questions.question: Does the file state that measures to reduce the loss are still to be taken (not yet carried out)?

questions.label: Q3
questions.question: Does the file state that household contents were stolen or damaged by a theft outside the insured location that was neither a burglary (the thief forcibly entered the building or a room of it, or broke open a container in it, or unlocked it with the correct keys or codes that the thief had obtained by burglary or robbery; a vehicle is not a container) or a robbery (theft under threat or use of violence against the policyholder or a member of the household, or while they could not resist because of unconsciousness, accident or death; pickpocketing and trick theft are not robbery)?

questions.label: Q4
questions.question: Does the file state that traces of the theft (for example pry marks, a broken lock, window or container) have been removed or altered, or are to be removed or altered, by the policyholder or on their behalf, for example by repair or cleaning?

questions.label: Q5
questions.question: Is a bicycle among the stolen or damaged items?

questions.label: Q6
questions.question: Does the policy, or the file, show that the policy does not include the separate supplementary insurance for simple theft away from home (einfacher Diebstahl auswärts)?

questions.label: Q7
questions.question: Does the file state that the original purchase vouchers for all of the stolen or damaged items cannot be obtained, or only at considerable cost (not even as a duplicate from the seller)?

text:
Dear Mr Palmer,

you asked whether the car can still be inspected. I'm afraid not as it was: my garage in Olten replaced the smashed rear window on 30 June, two days after the theft, and cleaned all the glass out of the boot and the back seat. The car looks normal again.

On the receipts, I can't help you, and I've really tried. The drone and the camera were bought from private sellers online, and the shop that sold me the binoculars closed down last year. I don't have any receipts and I can't get copies from anyone.

I've attached my policy.

Here's what happened, in case it didn't come across clearly on the phone. On Sunday 28 June 2026 my partner Laura Walsh and I drove to Basel for the day. I parked in a public car park near the zoo around ten and locked the car. The drone in its case, my camera bag and a pair of binoculars were in the boot under a blanket. When we came back at five, the rear side window was smashed and the boot had been emptied. The loss is CHF 7,250.

As far as the cover goes, I should point out that I've had the extra insurance for simple theft away from home since May 2026. It was added to my policy on 8 May, so it was already in place when this happened.

Best regards,
Chris Carter
Rosenweg 76, Olten
